Posia's ally Sena joined the war on attackers side

Frightened by Nansia, Tavilbia severed the defense pact with Inveria
Nansia's ally Nutangia joined the war on attackers side

markers.note: A vast collection of knowledge, including many rare and ancient tomes.

markers.name: Travelling World-famous Circus
markers.note: Roll up, roll up, this world-famous circus is here for a limited time only.

markers.name: Travelling Wondrous Circus
markers.note: Roll up, roll up, this wondrous circus is here for a limited time only.

markers.name: Chabertabe Competition
markers.note: Warriors from around the land gather for a competition of brutality in Chabertabe, with fame, fortune and favour on offer to the victor.

markers.name: Hrafjor Fair
markers.note: A fair is being held in Hrafjor, with all manner of local and foreign goods and services on offer.

markers.name: Minor Jetty
markers.note: A small location along the Chaber River to launch boats from sits here, along with a weary looking owner, willing to sell passage along the river.

markers.name: Wolves migration
markers.note: A huge group of wolves are migrating, whether part of their annual routine, or something more extraordinary.

markers.name: Distant mirage
markers.note: This distant mirage has been luring travellers out of their way for eons.

markers.name: Vopnafjor Grotto
markers.note: The Vopnafjor Grotto. Locals claim that it is endlessly deep and unexplored.

markers.name: Stansheadge Tomb
markers.note: A foreboding necropolis perched atop a jagged cliff, overlooking a desolate wasteland. Its towering walls harbor restless spirits, and the imposing gates bear the marks of countless battles and ancient curses.
